# Custom Copilot Instructions

This file contains custom instructions for GitHub Copilot specific to this Playwright Java project.

## Testing Standards

- All test classes should extend a base test class with common setup/teardown
- Use page object model pattern for browser interactions
- Annotate tests with @Test and use TestNG groups for categorization

## Code Style

- Follow Google Java style guide
- Use descriptive variable names for selectors and test data
- Document complex test scenarios with comments

## Dependencies

- Playwright Java: Browser automation
- TestNG: Test framework
- Allure: Reporting
- Maven: Build tool

Add project-specific instructions here that will help Copilot understand your conventions and generate better code.
